network.description: The big box is NOT one central box. The big box model clones itself worldwide: one big-box model over the entire earth. Each clone watches agents locally in its own region, shares every lesson globally with all clones, and is available on demand to any company anywhere.
network.on_demand: any company anywhere can call on any clone when needed

method: Deterministic mechanical replay through the REAL engine (engine.Sandbox) over REAL Red move sequences from runs/*/moves.jsonl, with the opening recipe loaded from fleet/lessons.json via fleet/lesson_executor.py. No model calls, no new live duels. Sequential mode mirrors learn-round3's structure (Red phase, Blue recipe, Red phase). Recipe pre-loaded mode (JSON key 'pretrained') applies the recipe to a fresh state before the wave — the fleet vision: hired agents arrive already holding the lesson. No weight training is involved anywhere.
